assertions.assertion: Agent upgrades M20IZO to business class.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not call `transfer_to_human_agents` for reservation IFOYYZ. The basic-economy denial is in-scope per policy and is a complete answer. (Transfer for NQNU5R is policy-warranted because portions have already been flown.)
assertions.rationale: The agent appropriately did not transfer for IFOYYZ after denying the cancellation—the policy-based denial for basic-economy outside the 24-hour window was a complete answer provided to the user in Turn 11. The agent only transferred for NQNU5R (Turn 16), which is correct because the already-flown segment requires human agent intervention per policy.

summary: Agent correctly denied both cancellations per policy, upgraded M20IZO to business class, and transferred only NQNU5R (with valid justification) while handling IFOYYZ denial without escalation.
